segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct PriceComparisonButtonsSubscriptionStoreControlStyle: SubscriptionStoreControlStyle { func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View { ForEach(configuration.options) { option in VStack { Button(localizedPrice(for: option), action: option.subscribe) if let priceComparison = priceComparison(for: option, allOptions: configuration.allOptions) { Text(priceComparison) } } } } // Helper methods for localizing text private func localizedPrice(for option: Configuration.Option) -> LocalizedStringKey { // Use 'displayPrice' and 'subscriptionPeriod' on 'option' to localize the price. // For example: "$9.99/month" } private func priceComparison(for option: Configuration.Option, allOptions: [Product]) -> LocalizedStringKey? { guard let subscriptionPeriod = option.subscriptionPeriod, subscriptionPeriod != .monthly else { return nil } let monthlyOption = allOptions.first { otherOption in otherOption.subscriptionPeriod == .monthly && otherOption.groupLevel == option.groupLevel } guard let monthlyOption else { return nil } // Create a localized string to represent the savings of subscribing to 'option' compared to paying per // month with 'monthlyOption'. For example, "Save $20.00 per year compared to the monthly option". } } ```
